Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** this is where we let user enter a action code and then validate it
** against valid_master_codes
*/

declare
 h_rtn_num number;

 cursor cur_actcd is
 select description, decode(numeral_value, 1, 'FIXED', 'FLOATING'), 
 eff_date, term_date
 from valid_master_codes
 where code = :drive_checklist_template.action_code
 and code_type = 'ACTCD';
/*
 and code not in ( 
 select action_code 
 from drive_checklist_template 
 where sponsor_id = 'DEFAULT' )
*/
begin
 if :drive_checklist_template.action_code is not null then
 begin
 if :drive_checklist_template.action_code is not null then
 open cur_actcd;
 fetch cur_actcd 
 into :drive_checklist_template.action_code_description, 
 :drive_checklist_template.target_date_status, 
 :drive_checklist_template.eff_date, 
 :drive_checklist_template.term_date;

 if cur_actcd%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_actcd;
 show_error('11321');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 close cur_actcd;
 end if;
 end;
 :drive_checklist_template.sort_seq := :system.cursor_record;
 end if;
-- message( 'Old Action code - ' || :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code ); pause;
-- message( 'New Action code - ' || :drive_checklist_template.action_code ); pause;
 if :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code != 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code then
 if :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code is not null then
 /*
 ** Its not a fresh entry, so exists in record group 
 ** delete from the record group before inserting the new one
 */
-- message( 'Old Action code not null - ' || :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code ); pause;
 check_insert_rg( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', 'C05', 
 :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code || ',', 'D', h_rtn_num );
 if ( h_rtn_num != 0 and h_rtn_num != 99999 ) then
-- show_error( '9199' );
 show_error( '11321' );
 check_package_failure;
 elsif h_rtn_num = 99999 then
 show_error( '11320' );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 if ( :drive_checklist_template.old_action_code is null 
 or (:drive_checklist_template.old_action_code != 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code)) then 
 /*
 ** populate the record group with new entry
 */
-- message( 'New Action code - ' || :drive_checklist_template.action_code ); pause;
 check_insert_rg( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', 'C05', 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code || ',', 'U', h_rtn_num );
-- message( to_char( h_rtn_num ) ); pause;
 if ( h_rtn_num != 0 and h_rtn_num != 99999 ) then
-- show_error( '9199' );
 show_error( '11321' );
 check_package_failure;
 elsif h_rtn_num = 99999 then
 show_error( '11320' );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: POST-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
/*
** retrieve information from the database.
*/
declare
 h_rtn_num number := 0 ;
 id_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc GroupColumn;

 cursor cur_actcd is
 select description
 from valid_master_codes
 where code = :drive_checklist_template.action_code
 and code_type = 'ACTCD';

begin
 /*
 ** first get description for resource code
 */
 begin
 if :drive_checklist_template.action_code is not null then
 open cur_actcd;
 fetch cur_actcd into :drive_checklist_template.action_code_description;

 if cur_actcd%NOTFOUND then
 close cur_actcd;
 show_error('11002');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 close cur_actcd;
 end if;
 end;

 if :drive_checklist_template.action_flag = '1' then
 :drive_checklist_template.target_date_status := 'FIXED';
 else
 :drive_checklist_template.target_date_status := 'FLOATING';
 end if;

 /*
 ** populate the record group with user selection
 */
 check_insert_rg( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', 'C05', 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code || ',', 'U', h_rtn_num );
 if h_rtn_num = 1 then
 show_error( '11321' );
-- show_error( '9199' );
 check_package_failure;
 elsif h_rtn_num != 0 then
 show_error( '11320' );
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

-- Modified for Y2K.....MG.....6/99
PROCEDURE initialise_windows IS
 h_rtn_status VARCHAR2(1) := '';
 h_alert_response number;

 id_rg RecordGroup;
 id_gc GroupColumn;
BEGIN
 --:global.program_version := '1.01.00';
 --:global.program_version := '2.03.00';
 --:global.program_version := '02';
 --:global.program_version := '03'; -- IM 8497
 --:global.program_version := '04'; -- Duplicate objects removal from GRP_LAF_STND
 
 -- Below Version Got Re-Updated from LT2018
 :global.program_version := '01';
 
-- read_image_file('lifelogo.bmp', 'BMP', 'banner.bc_logo');
 execute_trigger('util_banner');
 :system.message_level := '10';
 set_toolbar;

 begin
 /*
 ** we should check if global flag NO_DEFAULT_TEMPLATE is set to false
 ** if it is set to false, then your should be forced to create default template
 ** before anything else.
 */
 :global.no_default_template := '';
 if not is_default_available then
 default_value ('TRUE', 'global.no_default_template');
 else
 default_value ('FALSE', 'global.no_default_template');
 end if;


 if get_item_property('ctrl_block.template_id', enabled ) = 'FALSE' then

 end if;

 set_item_property('ctrl_block.template_id', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_TRUE);

 if :global.no_default_template = 'TRUE' then
 h_alert_response := show_alert('no_default_avail');
 if get_item_property('ctrl_block.template_id', enabled ) = 'FALSE' then
 item_change('ctrl_block.template_id', 'E');
 end if;
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_template_id_lov', 'E');
 item_change('ctrl_block.pb_retrieve_info', 'E');
 end if;
 :ctrl_block.template_id := 'DEFAULT';
 :ctrl_block.template_description := 'Default Drive Checklist';
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.template_id', UPDATEABLE, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 set_item_property('ctrl_block.template_id', INSERT_ALLOWED, PROPERTY_FALSE);
 end;

 /*
 ** set toolbar for drive_checklist_template block
 */
-- modify_toolbar_buttons('ctrl_block');
 modify_toolbar_buttons( 'drive_checklist_template' );
 /*
 ** create the record group for duplicate Action code check
 */
 create_rg( 'RG_CHECK_ACTION', 'C05' );

 go_block( 'drive_checklist_template' );
 check_package_failure;
 execute_query;
 check_package_failure;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: DO_SANITY_CHECK
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_sanity_check IS
BEGIN
 go_block('drive_checklist_template');
 if :system.cursor_block != 'DRIVE_CHECKLIST_TEMPLATE' then
 message (:system.cursor_block || ': Internal operation failed.');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 first_record;
 loop
/* message ('A ' || :system.cursor_record || ': ' || 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code || ', ' ||
 to_char(:drive_checklist_template.target_days) || ', ' ||
 :drive_checklist_template.time_flag );
*/
 if :drive_checklist_template.target_days is null or 
 :drive_checklist_template.time_flag = '' then
 go_item('drive_checklist_template.target_days');
 show_error('11050');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;

 first_record;
 loop
/* message ('B ' || :system.cursor_record || ': ' || 
 :drive_checklist_template.action_code || ', ' ||
 to_char(:drive_checklist_template.target_days) || ', ' ||
 :drive_checklist_template.time_flag );
*/
 if :drive_checklist_template.target_days > 0 and
 :drive_checklist_template.time_flag = 'DD' then
 go_item('drive_checklist_template.target_days');
 show_error('11051');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if :system.last_record = 'TRUE' then
 exit;
 else
 next_record;
 end if;
 end loop;

/*
** For the Action code in DEFAULT template delete records 
** from all other templates
*/
